ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, if all the algae are removed, which species directly gets affected?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The bottom of the food web is labeled “Algae and floating plants (algae and floating plants)”. From near this label, there is an arrow directly pointing upward to “Aquatic crustaceans (aquatic crustaceans)”; the figure also shows food relationships among other organisms such as fish, minnows, ducks, and raccoons. Reasoning: The question asks which species would be directly affected if all algae were removed. In the food web, arrows indicate the relationship from food source to eater, so the aquatic crustaceans that directly feed on algae and floating plants and are directly connected by this arrow would be directly affected. The answer is aquatic crustaceans.
